title: Draw-call budget for a desktop village scene
summary: On a mid-range laptop, a village scene stays at 60 fps when it holds under 150 draw calls and 750k triangles, with instancing carrying repeated props.
applies_when: desktop browser target, integrated or low-end discrete GPU
repeated props: trees, fences, lanterns, stones

values.per_prop_triangles_max: 2000 for anything repeated more than 20 times
values.instance_threshold: more than 8 identical props -> one InstancedMesh

checks: draw calls counted from the renderer, not estimated
texture memory counted after decode, not from file size
frame time measured on the target machine, not extrapolated from triangle count
no shadow-casting light that covers the whole set at map size above 2048
limits: numbers assume a 1280x720 to 1920x1080 render target
does not cover VR or mobile, which need roughly half
